remarks: Set on a scenic pond and tucked away on a private back lot, this four-bedroom, two full and two half bath property presents an exceptional opportunity for renovation or new construction. Sited on 1.31 acres, the setting offers tranquil pond views, mature landscaping, and a high level of privacy.  The existing home features an open floor plan, a stone fireplace that adds character and warmth, and an on-site tennis court, offering additional lifestyle potential. Features a separate entrance office. The property requires substantial renovation and is best suited for buyers seeking a build-your-own or full renovation project. The primary value lies in the land, location, and amenities, providing a rare chance to reimagine or rebuild in a peaceful, natural setting.  An ideal opportunity for builders, investors, or end users looking to create a custom home with water views, privacy, and recreational amenities in a sought-after location.
